notes: Source: 'INDIVIDUAL RECORDS' pp. 354-372 of the 2026 media guide (table of contents: Records And History p331). Used: rushing p358-359, passing p360-363, receiving p364-366, sacks p366, interceptions p367. The layout is a value column followed by the names; ties are extra names under one value; no rank numbers are printed, so rank = competition rank by printed value (tie=true on every row sharing a printed value).

through_season 2025: the 2026 media guide (IA item ...-2026-media-guide-c) lists 2025-season entries (Brock Bowers vs. Jax. Nov. 2, 2025, Ashton Jeanty 2025 rookie rows on p358, Maxx Crosby 2019-25, Daniel Carlson Jan. 4, 2026 on p335).

Scope: the Individual Records are the regular-season lists; the guide prints Individual Playoff Records separately (pp. 459-461) and those were not used. No asterisks or postseason marks appear in the transcribed lists.

Franchise lists: the guide mixes the Oakland, Los Angeles and Las Vegas years in one list (e.g. Art Powell 1963-66, Marcus Allen 1982-92, Maxx Crosby 2019-25); AFL-era players are included as printed.

Two game rows are 'N times; last: ...' lines (rec_td game: 19 games at 3 TD, last Brock Bowers; sacks game: 25 games at 3.0 sacks, last Malcolm Koonce). They are kept as one row each with the last game's date, fields times and note, hidden_tie=true: the other games and players are not printed.
Game lists with a printed maximum shared by many games: rush_td game (18 rows, all 3 TD) and int game (8 rows, all 3 INT) are fully tied at rank 1.
No tackles list exists anywhere in the guide, so career/season/game tackles are in missing.

Names as printed (e.g. Mark van Eeghen, Napoleon Kaufman, Hewritt Dixon, Kamerion Wimbley). Cliff Branch's career rec_td years print '1972-84' while his rec and rec_yds rows print '1972-85' (guide-internal inconsistency, kept as printed).

Not used: the 'Top Seasons' picture pages (pp. 382-384), Annual Leaders (pp. 373-376), 'Times Sacked' (a quarterback-sacked list), 'Most Passes Had Intercepted' (thrown), team records, opponent records and playoff pages.
